reading.body:
OpenStreetMap tags a location in Sansepolcro, Italy as a data center under the name WinEuropa, but the name and available evidence suggest it is an IT reseller or regional support business, not a commercial data-center operator.

The distinction matters because regional IT businesses maintain office infrastructure for their own operations, not colocation or cloud capacity for external customers. A tag mislabeling a sales office as a data-center creates noise in any map of infrastructure where compute density and power demand are the relevant metrics. This entry cannot be verified as a true data-center facility.

The research was exhausted before confirming WinEuropa's actual business line against company registration or public web presence. The entry is filed as a probable mistag based on naming alone. Any use of OpenStreetMap telecom tags for infrastructure planning should account for tagging errors of this kind, where name and category do not align.
